levels.surface: علي بن أحمد بن محمد بن عمران الدقاق

notes: narrated encounter: Imam Rida speaks and argues («فقال أبو الحسن عليه السلام») inside Safwan's account; whether he is the source or only in the scene is not settled (rule 11), so he is not added
«سألني أبو قرة المحدث» : Abu Qurra's request is in the scene, not a transmission (rule 6); the blessing and «رحمه الله» are left out
